feeds.title: The Positive MOM
feeds.description: Covers Stories, Strategies, and Steps to inspire moms to find peace, break unhealthy cycles, and feel whole. Author Elayna Fernandez is a Latina Storyteller, award-winning Story Strategist, and avid Student of Pain.

feeds.title: Laura Fuentes
feeds.description: I'm Laura Fuentes. I inspire moms to live a healthy lifestyle while juggling their family and work with fresh recipes and practical advice.

feeds.title: My Dominican Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: I'm Vanessa and it is my pleasure to welcome you to My Dominican Kitchen, a bilingual food blog where we help busy moms put together tasty traditional Dominican and Latin-inspired meals without having to spend tons of time in the kitchen. Browse hundreds of authentic delicious dishes all with detailed step-by-step tutorials and expert tips!

feeds.title: Trendy Latina
feeds.description: I'm Claudia ! Native Brazilian mom, linguist, teacher, content creator, fashion influencer, speaker, and entrepreneur. I'm passionate about sharing life, beauty, small moments; hoping to empower others to breach their limits and live a more colorful, happy, healthier, trendy LIFE!

feeds.title: Mommy Maestra
feeds.description: A site for Latino homeschoolers and parents who want to get more involved in their children's education. Author Monica Olivera is a Latina homeschooling mother of three, and an education writer.

feeds.title: Cleverly Me
feeds.description: Cleverly Me is a blog run by a Miami-based mom, covering topics such as parenting, food, and travel. Their blog features personal stories, product reviews, and recipes. The mission of Cleverly Me is to provide a community for moms to share their experiences and inspire each other to live their best lives.

feeds.title: Mama XXI
feeds.description: Covers articles on Entertainment, Women & Beauty, Education, Food & Recipes, and Family. Author Romina Tibytt is a Latina mom living in greater Philadelphia.

feeds.title: Mami of Multiples
feeds.description: An Award-Winning Parenting Resources and Lifestyle Tips from a Latina American Mom and Mompreneur. The author covers articles on Beauty, Latinos, Entertainment, Family, Parenting, Technology, Shopping, Holidays, and Faith.

feeds.title: Mama Latina Tips
feeds.description: Born and raised in Mexico, where she worked as a human resources executive and university instructor, Silvia moved to California 16 years ago where she lives with her husband and two very active boys. She loves dancing, cooking, watching movies, reading, throwing Mexican parties, and spending time with her family and friends.

feeds.title: Isabel Eats
feeds.description: Here at Isabel Eats, you'll find a mix of all your favorite authentic Mexican recipes as well as Mexican-inspired dishes with a twist! Anything from Mexican Stuffed Peppers and a Healthy Avocado Salad to ooey-gooey cheesy Red Chicken Enchiladas and delicious Tres Leches Cake!

feeds.title: Spanish Mama Blog
feeds.description: Resources for Teaching Language & Spanglish Living. Spanish Mama offers ideas and help for the language classroom and Spanglish families. I'm Elisabeth, the teacher and mother behind Spanish Mama. I actually never expected to speak Spanish, teach Spanish, or raise my kids in it. I created this little corner of the internet because life surprised me. I did learn a second language, and later, I discovered resources that gave me confidence as a teacher and parent.

feeds.title: The Kisha Project
feeds.description: The author Kisha is an Afro-Latina wife, mom, and former flight attendant. Born in Panama, raised in Little Rock currently residing in Phoenix. She shares insights about motherhood, parenting, lifestyle, and much more on her blog.

feeds.title: Las Mamacitas Blog
feeds.description: I'm an Latina mom lifestyle blogger. I love to organize empowering events for Mamacitas in LA and San Diego. Las Mamacitas connects brands to our network of women, influencers and small business owners through sponsored opportunities and activations.

feeds.title: Easy Living Today
feeds.description: I'm Jessica Alzamora, a latina blogger from Chicago, mommy of two toddler boys and a fitness and healthy lifestyle enthusiast. My goal with Easy Living Today is to help other people live their fittest and happiest lives, without overcomplicating the process.

feeds.title: Queen Bee Latina
feeds.description: I am Angela Saldaña Camacho aka 'Queen Bee Latina' I am mom of four, Lifestyle blogger with a passion for the arts, good food, culture, fashion and travel.

feeds.title: Modernmami
feeds.description: Family Fun, Easy Recipes, and Parenting Stories from a Latina Mom & Tampa Bay Area Award-Winning Blogger Melanie Edwards.

feeds.title: Maritere Rodriguez Bellas Blog
feeds.description: Covers Parenting Advice, Anti-racist Bilingual & Bicultural Tips & Tricks, Book Reviews, and Family Life. Author Maritere R. Bellas is an international award-winning bilingual, bicultural Latina author, parenting topic expert, and speaker.

feeds.title: Funtastic Life
feeds.description: FuntasticLife is all about encouraging others to live their best life. Also covers articles on Travel, Entertainment, Money, Food, Beauty, Fashion, Events, Reviews & More. Author Leanette Fernandez is a Latina Blogger, Wife & Mom of two.

feeds.title: Sprinkle DIY Blog
feeds.description: Author Felicita Moncada is a Latina mom of two from South Florida who spends most of her time crafting, reading, drinking coffee, or napping.

feeds.title: Latina on a Mission
feeds.description: My name is Migdalia Rivera and I am the Founder of Latina On a Mission. Follow this 'Latina On a Mission' to learn how I thrive while living frugally and raising two boys on my own. My life is 'Latinalicious' because I live life to the fullest, without going into debt.

feeds.title: Alicia Ever After Blog
feeds.description: Covers Lifestyle, Photography, Travel, Fashion, DIY, Food & Recipes, Haircare, Beauty, Event planning, Gift ideas, Health, and Fitness. Author Alicia Gibbs wants to empower Latinas to always lead by example by both looking and feeling good inside and out without breaking the bank.

feeds.title: Ana Jacqueline Blog
feeds.description: Originally launched in 2015 as a way of inspiring others to stick to their fitness journey; today my site is much more than that. I am a stay-at-home mom of three, a wife, content creator, media manager and small business owner.

feeds.title: New Mom in a New Era
feeds.description: A Latina mom about motherhood, food, fashion, travel, and Latina lifestyle in Houston, Texas.

feeds.title: Mamá Latina Blog
feeds.description: I am Caro Mejía, a mother of 2 children and a journalist documenting motherhood with love and humor. I love traveling as a family, creating new recipes and connecting with other moms in a real way, without filters and eager to be our best version.

feeds.title: NYC Tech Mommy
feeds.description: Inspiring families to live simple, live fun, and live life by sharing family lifestyle, tech and travel. Author Monica Encarnacion is born and raised in New Yorker, former educator, Latina, and mommy of two.

feeds.title: Candypolooza
feeds.description: Candypolooza is a lifestyle site written from a woman's point of view. Sharing all of the fun a military life, raising a family & enjoying life via food, entertainment, and travel.
